useCase: Ancestor birthplace chart (#MyColorfulAncestry): a 5-generation pedigree from GEDCOM fields, each ancestor cell coloured by birth state or country with a legend, the chart genealogists build and colour by hand in Excel
who: Hobby genealogists and family historians who post ancestor charts in Facebook genealogy groups and on genealogy blogs (Genea-Musings, DNAeXplained, the weekly #52Ancestors prompt), working from the GEDCOM file their genealogy program exports
title: Ancestor Birthplace Chart
